title: CHEESE TIMBALES
instructions: --Crumble into timbale cups, alternate layers of bread and American cheese. Pour over them a mixture of eggs,  milk,  salt,  pepper and mustard, allowing one egg and a tablespoonful of milk to each timbale. Cook in the oven or on top of the stove in a shallow pan of hot water, kept covered.
